checkpoint_wrapper_module: wrap an nn.Module with activation checkpointing to reduce GPU memory usage during training
offload_wrapper_module: wrap an nn.Module with activation offloading to save intermediate activations on CPU
apply_activation_checkpointing_model: apply activation checkpointing to all Linear submodules within a PyTorch model
checkpoint_wrapper_reentrant: wrap a module with reentrant checkpoint implementation to support keyword arguments in checkpointed forward calls
checkpoint_impl_enum: create a CheckpointImpl enum value to select between reentrant and non-reentrant checkpoint behavior
